text: dsh-media-tools 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的媒体处理插件，通过 Cordis 分别接入音频和视频工具。它可分析音频波形、频谱与数字电平，编辑并转换音频，读取视频元数据，也可调用配置好的后端转录语音或分析视频。输出包括图表、报告和新媒体文件，适合在 DSH 工作区处理录音与视频片段。需要本机媒体工具；部分转录和模型功能依赖本地配置，GPU 原生运行时可能从 GitHub 下载。

dsh-media-tools adds audio and video tools to DSH Web. It measures audio spectra and levels, edits or converts media, reads video metadata, and uses configured backends for transcription or video analysis. It returns plots and new files. Local media tools and model setup may be required.
想在 DSH 里查看录音的波形、频谱和音量数据。
能不能把一段音频剪短、调音量并另存为 WAV？
I need to convert a video clip or audio track into another media format from DSH.
dsh-media-tools 的功能「音频测量与编辑」：分析音频的波形、频谱和数字电平，也可按时间段剪辑、调节增益并输出新的 WAV 文件。
dsh-media-tools 的功能「视频工具」：读取视频元数据、转换为 MP4、WebM 或 GIF，也可将问题交给已配置的视频分析后端。
dsh-media-tools 使用前须知：配置 GPU 原生后端时，安装流程会从 GitHub 下载版本化运行时资源；相关地址列在 native-runtime.json。

dsh-media-tools README · dsh-media-tools：Two independent DSH/Cordis plugins, agent skills, a CLI and a stdio MCP server, with included on-demand Omni listening and native temporal video backends. The old Local AI v2 application does not need to run.

| Plugin | Selectable tools |
| --- | --- |
| Audio | `analyze_audio`, `edit_audio`, `convert_audio`, `transcribe_audio`, `listen_audio` |
| Video | `probe_video`, `convert_video`, `analyze_video` |

dsh-media-tools README · dsh-media-tools：Audio analysis returns inline waveform/FFT/spectrogram and waterfall plots, measured digital levels, and numerical spectrum data. Editing creates a new WAV. Conversion supports audio extraction plus WAV/FLAC/MP3/M4A/OGG and MP4/WebM/GIF. CPU Whisper supplies timestamped speech. Omni supplies fallible sound descriptions. Native video preserves temporal frames, aligned audio and engine evidence.

dsh-media-tools README · Install：```bash
git clone https://github.com/averyjohnkucan-arch/dsh-media-tools.git
cd dsh-media-tools
npm ci
node src/install.mjs --setup-python \

dsh-media-tools README · Install：This installs both skills into `~/.agents/skills`, copies the runtime into a versioned directory under `~/.local/share/dsh-media-tools`, and configures `~/.config/dsh-media/config.json`. It uses V2 **once as an import source**, copies native executables into its own cache, and reuses the model store. The old V2 application and inference companion can stay stopped. On Linux, an available standalone Python distribution is also imported into package-owned storage when no `--python` is specified. Moving the plugin checkout does not break the installed skills.

dsh-media-tools README · Install：FFmpeg and FFprobe binaries install automatically through pinned npm dependencies. Python 3.12 with venv/pip and an NVIDIA driver are host prerequisites. Setup installs the CUDA user-space runtime libraries. The native executable bundle currently targets Linux x64/CUDA 13; Windows/macOS GPU execution is not qualified. CPU tools use the platform FFmpeg dependencies where available.

dsh-media-tools README · Install：For a fresh machine with separately selected models, replace `--local-ai` with `--backend-config /path/to/backend-models.json`. Setup downloads and SHA256-verifies this repo's versioned native runtime asset. Model weights are large and remain separate: Omni plus its projector is about 21 GB; native video may need considerably more. See [standalone backend setup](docs/standalone-backends.md).

dsh-media-tools README · Install：For CPU tools only, omit `--include-backends` and `--local-ai`; configure `--whisper-model /path/to/faster-whisper-model` for speech. Existing unowned or locally edited skills are preserved; upgrades stop before replacing them. Previous runtime releases remain for rollback. `node src/install.mjs --uninstall` removes only owned, unchanged skills and preserves models, config and workspace outputs.

dsh-media-tools README · DSH：Target: DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` and Cordis `~4.0.5`. Package and install from your chosen DSH profile:

```bash
npm pack
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/dsh-media-tools-0.2.2.tgz
```

dsh-media-tools README · DSH：The package inserts `dsh-media-audio` and `dsh-media-video` as independently switchable plugins. They use DSH tool registration, attachments, prompt sections and Cordis lifecycle cleanup; no host source patch is needed. Disabling either cancels its owned work and removes its registrations. It never deletes generated files or models. Individual inserts are also in `audio.patch.yml` and `video.patch.yml`.

dsh-media-tools README · DSH：Where installed, DSH's `modelScheduler` service handles GPU admission so managed models can unload before media inference and resume afterward. The workers also hold a package-owned lock and refuse to collide with an unrelated GPU owner. MCP clients cannot control another application's private scheduler: unload an unrelated resident model before standalone GPU inference.
dsh-media-tools README · DSH：Do not register duplicate tool names through both the direct plugins and MCP in one DSH profile. The installer does not modify a live DSH profile or reload DSH.

dsh-media-tools README · MCP：The official MCP SDK server exposes all eight tools and returns plot image blocks, saved files and report JSON. Select tools normally in your client. Audio playback uses returned WAV paths where the client supports it. Allow a long tool timeout for GPU jobs. For Codex, the setup syntax is documented in [official MCP configuration](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/extend/mcp).

dsh-media-tools README · CLI：```bash
node src/cli.mjs doctor
node src/cli.mjs analyze_audio --workspace /path/to/workspace \
  --args '{"source_path":"recording.mp3","duration_seconds":30,"fft_size":8192}'
node src/cli.mjs listen_audio --workspace /path/to/workspace \

CLI/MCP paths are relative to the explicitly authorized workspace. DSH can use the latest single media upload or an attachment ID. Outputs are unique `.dsh-media` directories; originals stay unchanged. See [conversion recipes](docs/conversion.md).

dsh-media-tools README · CLI：**Model requirement:** `analyze_video` is specifically for models with native temporal video support and a compatible engine/projector. User deployment examples include Flash 3.8, Flash Next, Qwen 3.6 35B-A3B and Qwen 27B. These are deployment labels, not a tested compatibility matrix. Each model/engine/projector combination needs qualification. The bundled native path preserves 6 FPS, 15-second windows, 3-second overlap, SVE2 records and M-RoPE traces. It never replaces temporal video with independent still frames.

dsh-media-tools README · CLI：Numerical audio segments are at most 120 seconds and 25 million channel-samples. Input size is at most 2 GiB. CPU transcription and conversions/edits are bounded to two hours; conversions default to the first 30 seconds. Numerical levels are dBFS, not calibrated SPL. Whisper likelihoods are not correctness percentages. Omni captions can hallucinate; compare descriptions with measured evidence.

dsh-media-tools README · Development and provenance：Run `npm ci && npm test` with the pinned Python requirements; `DSH_MEDIA_PYTHON` selects the interpreter. Optional live inference checks are separate from the normal CPU/MCP/Cordis suite. See [validation](docs/validation.md), [advanced backends](docs/backends.md), [source provenance](provenance.json) and [third-party notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

dsh-media-tools README · Development and provenance：The portable CPU runner enforces path checks, not an OS sandbox. The included Linux GPU backend runs owned processes with per-job scratch, bounded inputs and cancellation. Native executable assets and vendored Strata/llama components keep their licenses. Private settings, credentials, chat histories, recordings and model weights are not checked into this repository.

dsh-media-tools README · Recommended models and exact identities：Run `npm run models -- list` to inspect the configured Omni, Whisper and native-video model identities and exact hashes/revisions. To fetch a complete pinned set, run `npm run models -- download omni-captioner /absolute/model/storage` or use `whisper-small`. The command resumes partial files, verifies content, prints progress and writes `download-receipt.json`. Configure the resulting paths using the standalone backend setup instructions above. Model download does not launch inference or change private settings. Native video additionally requires a compatible complete checkpoint, projector and prepared runtime pack; a projector alone is insufficient.
